```{r cars,fig.width=16,fig.height=20}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
rm(list = ls())

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)   # <-- 新增：读取 Excel

# ---------- Input file (single Excel with 3 sheets) ----------
data_dir  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data"
input_xlsx <- file.path(data_dir, "Fig4_data.xlsx")

# Sheet 名称与站点名称一致
sheet_NB <- "NB"
sheet_MB <- "MB"
sheet_SB <- "SB"

# ---------- Color for each site ----------
site_colors <- c(NB = "#7030A0",
                 MB = "#2E75B6",
                 SB = "#A8D5CE")

# ---------- Number formatting ----------
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  out <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
  idx <- abs(x) < 0.5 * 10^(-digits)
  out[idx] <- sprintf("%.1e", x[idx])
  out
}

# ==============================================================================
# Generic plotting function
#   show_x_axis: whether to show x-axis labels; angle_x: rotation angle
# ==============================================================================
make_boxplot <- function(data, yvar, ylab, color, tag_label = NULL,
                         show_x_axis = FALSE, angle_x = 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n########## %s — Shapiro-Wilk normality test ##########\n", yvar))
  shapiro_ctrl <- data %>% filter(treatment == "Control")       %>% pull(!!sym(yvar)) %>% shapiro.test()
  shapiro_n    <- data %>% filter(treatment == "Fertilization") %>% pull(!!sym(yvar)) %>% shapiro.test()
  cat("Control p:", shapiro_ctrl$p.value, "\n")
  cat("Fertilization p:", shapiro_n$p.value, "\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("\n########## %s — Levene test for homogeneity of variance ##########\n", yvar))
  fml <- as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ treatment"))
  lev <- leveneTest(fml, data = data)
  print(lev)
  
  # Welch's t-test (unequal variances)
  diff_test <- data %>%
    t_test(fml, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s two-sided Welch t-test result ===\n", yvar))
  print(diff_test)
  
  y_max <- max(data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_label_pos <- y_max + 0.12 * y_range
  
  # plotmath expression: italic t and italic p; values quoted to support e-notation
  diff_test <- diff_test %>%
    mutate(
      p_label = sprintf("italic(t) == \"%s\" * ',' ~ italic(p) == \"%s\"",
                        fmt_num(statistic), fmt_num(p)),
      x_pos = 1.5,
      y_pos = y_label_pos
    )
  
  group_colors <- c(color, color)
  
  x_text_theme <- if (show_x_axis) {
    if (angle_x == 0) {
      element_text(colour = "black", size = 28, face = "bold")
    } else {
      element_text(colour = "black", size = 28, face = "bold",
                   angle = angle_x, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
    }
  } else {
    element_blank()
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = treatment, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = treatment),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
      size = 6, alpha = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
    geom_text(
      data = diff_test,
      aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = p_label),
      size = 9, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE,
      parse = TRUE,            # ← 解析 plotmath 表达式
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = ylab, tag = tag_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x  = x_text_theme,
      axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 24, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 24, face = "bold", angle = 90),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = if (show_x_axis) element_line(color = "black") else element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
    )
  return(p)
}

# ---------- Read and tidy data for one site (from a given Excel sheet) ----------
read_site <- function(xlsx_file, sheet_name) {
  da <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = sheet_name)
  da <- da %>%
    filter(treatment %in% c("CK", "N")) %>%
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment,
                              levels = c("CK", "N"),
                              labels = c("Control", "Fertilization")))
  return(da)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Generate 4 panels for one site
# (only the last row "hp" shows x-axis labels, rotated 45°)
# ==============================================================================
make_site_panels <- function(xlsx_file, sheet_name, site_name) {
  da <- read_site(xlsx_file, sheet_name)
  col <- site_colors[[site_name]]
  vars  <- c("pH",  "MRG", "ARG", "hp")
  ylabs <- c("Soil pH", "MRGs", "ARGs", "PHPs")
  
  tag_letters <- list(
    NB = c("a", "b", "c", "d"),
    MB = c("e", "f", "g", "h"),
    SB = c("i", "j", "k", "l")
  )
  tags <- tag_letters[[site_name]]
  
  panels <- lapply(seq_along(vars), function(i) {
    is_last_row <- (vars[i] == "hp")
    make_boxplot(da, vars[i], ylabs[i], col,
                 tag_label   = tags[i],
                 show_x_axis = is_last_row,
                 angle_x     = if (is_last_row) 45 else 0)
  })
  names(panels) <- vars
  return(panels)
}

# ---------- Generate panels for the three sites ----------
cat("\n=========== Site of NB ===========\n")
nb <- make_site_panels(input_xlsx, sheet_NB, "NB")

cat("\n=========== Site of MB ===========\n")
mb <- make_site_panels(input_xlsx, sheet_MB, "MB")

cat("\n=========== Site of SB ===========\n")
sb <- make_site_panels(input_xlsx, sheet_SB, "SB")

# ---------- Add column titles to the top panel (pH row) of each column ----------
add_col_title <- function(p, title) {
  p + labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold",
                                hjust = 0.5, color = "black",
                                margin = margin(b = 10))
    )
}

nb$pH <- add_col_title(nb$pH, "Site of NB")
mb$pH <- add_col_title(mb$pH, "Site of MB")
sb$pH <- add_col_title(sb$pH, "Site of SB")

# ---------- Assemble 4 rows × 3 cols ----------
row_pH  <- nb$pH  | mb$pH  | sb$pH
row_MRG <- nb$MRG | mb$MRG | sb$MRG
row_ARG <- nb$ARG | mb$ARG | sb$ARG
row_hp  <- nb$hp  | mb$hp  | sb$hp

p_all <- (row_pH) / (row_MRG) / (row_ARG) / (row_hp) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation()

p_all <- p_all & theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"))

print(p_all)

# ---------- Save ----------
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig4a-l.pdf",
       plot = p_all, width = 16, height = 20, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.width=44,fig.height=36}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(ggh4x)
library(agricolae)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Read data (from Fig4_data.xlsx, sheet "WN")
# ==============================================================================
xlsx_file <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig4_data.xlsx"

df <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = "WN") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# 如果 Excel 第一列是行号索引（对应原 row.names = 1），改用：
# df <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = "WN") %>%
#   column_to_rownames(var = names(.)[1])

df <- df %>%
  rename(paraments = paraments) %>%
  mutate(
    Water.Level = factor(Water.Level,
                         levels = c("Conventional.watering", "Reduced.watering"),
                         labels = c("CI", "RI")),
    Fertilization = factor(Fertilization.Level,
                           levels = c("N0", "N7", "N14", "N21", "N28")),
    Year = factor(Year,
                  levels = c("Wheat.2018", "Maize.2021", "Wheat.2022"),
                  labels = c("Wheat 2018", "Maize 2021", "Wheat 2022")),
    time = factor(time.point, levels = c("TP1", "TP2", "TP3", "TP4")),
    paraments = factor(paraments, levels = c("pH", "Fe", "Mn", "Cu", "MRG", "ARG"))
  ) %>%
  filter(paraments %in% c("pH", "Fe", "Mn", "Cu", "MRG", "ARG")) %>%
  filter(Year %in% c("Maize 2021", "Wheat 2022")) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("\n=========== Data check (keep only Maize 2021 + Wheat 2022) ===========\n")
cat("Year levels: ", paste(levels(df$Year), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of facets per parameter = ",
    n_distinct(interaction(df$Water.Level, df$Year, df$time)),
    " (should be 2 x 2 x 4 = 16)\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Tukey HSD via agricolae for plot letters
# ==============================================================================
sig_data <- df %>%
  group_by(paraments, Water.Level, Year, time) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, ...) {
    if (n_distinct(d$Fertilization) < 2) {
      return(tibble(Fertilization = unique(d$Fertilization), letter = NA_character_))
    }
    if (min(table(d$Fertilization)) < 2) {
      return(tibble(Fertilization = unique(d$Fertilization), letter = NA_character_))
    }
    fit <- aov(concentration ~ Fertilization, data = d)
    hsd <- HSD.test(fit, trt = "Fertilization", unbalanced = TRUE, console = FALSE)
    res <- hsd$groups
    res$Fertilization <- rownames(res)
    tibble(
      Fertilization = as.character(res$Fertilization),
      letter = trimws(res$groups)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Position of letter labels
# ==============================================================================
label_pos <- df %>%
  group_by(paraments, Water.Level, Year, time, Fertilization) %>%
  summarise(x_pos = max(concentration, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

plot_labels <- sig_data %>%
  left_join(label_pos,
            by = c("paraments", "Water.Level", "Year", "time", "Fertilization"))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Color palette
# ==============================================================================
my_colors <- c(
  "N0"  = "#6A9B3F",
  "N7"  = "#8762B0",
  "N14" = "#6C9FCC",
  "N21" = "#C99C4B",
  "N28" = "#CE4A3D"
)

bg_color_map <- c(
  "pH"  = "#E6EEF6",   # 浅蓝
  "Mn"  = "#E6EEF6",   # 浅蓝
  "MRG" = "#E6EEF6",   # 浅蓝
  "Fe"  = "#FBE7E7",   # 浅红
  "Cu"  = "#FBE7E7",   # 浅红
  "ARG" = "#FBE7E7"    # 浅红
)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Dunnett statistics
# ==============================================================================
dunnett_results <- df %>%
  group_by(paraments, Water.Level, Year, time) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, ...) {
    if (!"N0" %in% as.character(d$Fertilization)) return(tibble())
    if (n_distinct(d$Fertilization) < 2)          return(tibble())
    if (min(table(d$Fertilization)) < 2)          return(tibble())
    
    fit <- aov(concentration ~ Fertilization, data = d)
    emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ Fertilization)
    ctr <- contrast(emm, "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "N0", adjust = "dunnett")
    ctr_df <- as.data.frame(ctr)
    
    tibble(
      contrast = as.character(ctr_df$contrast),
      estimate = ctr_df$estimate,
      p.value  = ctr_df$p.value,
      sig      = as.integer(ctr_df$p.value < 0.05)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(level_vs_N0 = sub(" - N0", "", contrast))

summary_by_param_64 <- dunnett_results %>%
  group_by(paraments) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig   = sum(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    denom   = 64,
    prop    = n_sig / denom,
    pct_sig = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * prop),
    pct_nonsig = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * (1 - prop)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(paraments, c("pH","Fe","Mn","Cu","MRG","ARG")))

cat("\n=========== Each parameter: significant count / 64 and percentage ===========\n")
print(summary_by_param_64)

nonsig_map <- setNames(summary_by_param_64$pct_nonsig,
                       as.character(summary_by_param_64$paraments))

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Single parameter plotting function
#    show_y_strips = TRUE  → 显示 Year/TP 的 y 方向分面标签（仅 ARG）
#    show_y_strips = FALSE → 完全去掉 y 方向 strip（不留空间）
# ==============================================================================
make_param_plot <- function(param,
                            show_legend   = FALSE,
                            show_y_title  = FALSE,
                            show_y_strips = FALSE) {
  
  df_sub  <- df          %>% filter(paraments == param)
  lab_sub <- plot_labels %>% filter(paraments == param)
  
  bg_fill_color <- bg_color_map[[param]]
  
  # x 方向（CI / RI）条带始终显示
  x_strip_bg <- list(
    element_rect(fill = "white"),
    element_rect(fill = "gray90")
  )
  x_strip_text <- element_text(face = "bold", size = 48, color = "black",
                               margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6, l = 6, r = 6))
  
  # 根据 show_y_strips 决定 y 方向 strip 显 / 隐
  if (show_y_strips) {
    my_strip <- strip_nested(
      background_x = x_strip_bg,
      background_y = list(
        element_rect(fill = "white"),
        element_rect(fill = "gray90")
      ),
      text_x = x_strip_text,
      text_y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 48, color = "black",
                            margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6, l = 6, r = 6)),
      by_layer_x = TRUE,
      by_layer_y = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    # ★ 直接 element_blank()，不占任何空间
    my_strip <- strip_nested(
      background_x = x_strip_bg,
      background_y = element_blank(),
      text_x       = x_strip_text,
      text_y       = element_blank(),
      by_layer_x   = TRUE,
      by_layer_y   = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  base_lab <- switch(param,
                     "pH"  = "Soil pH",
                     "Fe"  = "Fe",
                     "Mn"  = "Mn",
                     "Cu"  = "Cu",
                     "MRG" = "MRGs",
                     "ARG" = "ARGs")
  x_lab <- paste0(base_lab, " (", nonsig_map[[param]], ")")
  
  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = concentration, y = Fertilization, fill = Fertilization)) +
    
    geom_rect(
      data        = data.frame(x = 1),
      aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill        = bg_fill_color,
      alpha       = 1
    ) +
    
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, outlier.size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    
    geom_point(
      aes(color = Fertilization),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.2, seed = 123),
      size = 5.5, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = lab_sub,
      aes(x = x_pos, y = Fertilization, label = letter),
      size = 8, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_discrete(limits = c("N0", "N7", "N14", "N21", "N28")) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = my_colors,
      name   = "N levels",
      guide  = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_colors, guide = "none") +
    
    facet_nested(
      Year + time ~ Water.Level,
      scales = "free_x",
      strip  = my_strip
    ) +
    
    labs(
      y = "Nitrogen addition levels",
      x = x_lab
    ) +
    
    theme_bw(base_size = 22) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "black",
                                  angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 42, color = "black",
                                  margin = margin(t = 18)),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        face   = "bold",
        size   = 42,
        color  = if (show_y_title) "black" else "transparent",
        margin = margin(r = 6)
      ),
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      strip.text.x    = x_strip_text,
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 42, face = "bold"),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 42, face = "bold"),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.8, "cm"),
      # ★ 顶部留白加大，给上移的 tag 字母留空间
      plot.margin     = margin(t = 75, r = 1, b = 3, l = 1)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 7. Generate six plots
# ==============================================================================
p_pH  <- make_param_plot("pH",  show_legend = FALSE, show_y_title = TRUE,  show_y_strips = FALSE)
p_Fe  <- make_param_plot("Fe",  show_legend = FALSE, show_y_title = FALSE, show_y_strips = FALSE)
p_Mn  <- make_param_plot("Mn",  show_legend = FALSE, show_y_title = FALSE, show_y_strips = FALSE)
p_Cu  <- make_param_plot("Cu",  show_legend = FALSE, show_y_title = FALSE, show_y_strips = FALSE)
p_MRG <- make_param_plot("MRG", show_legend = FALSE, show_y_title = FALSE, show_y_strips = FALSE)
p_ARG <- make_param_plot("ARG", show_legend = TRUE,  show_y_title = FALSE, show_y_strips = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 8. Combine plots
# ==============================================================================
p_all <- (p_pH | p_Fe | p_Mn | p_Cu | p_MRG | p_ARG) +
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    widths = rep(1, 6)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = list(c("m", "n", "o", "p", "q", "r"))
  )
p_all <- p_all &
  theme(
    # ★ 关键修复：y = 1.0 保持原位，vjust = 0 让文字向上延伸（进入顶部边距）
    plot.tag          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 48, color = "black",
                                     hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1.0),
    panel.spacing.x   = unit(0.02, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y   = unit(0.02, "cm"),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.direction  = "horizontal",
    legend.box        = "horizontal",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 42, face = "bold",
                                     margin = margin(r = 16)),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 42, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size   = unit(1.8, "cm"),
    legend.margin     = margin(t = 6, b = 6)
  )
print(p_all)

# ==============================================================================
# 9. Save figure
# ==============================================================================
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig4m-p.pdf", p_all,
       width = 44, height = 36, dpi = 300)
```
